04 — HOW I WORK

From theme to final file.

The same four moves, applied to every brief regardless of size.

01

Read the theme

Every event has a message before it has a poster. I start by understanding the audience, the occasion and the one thing the design needs to communicate first.

02

Build the hierarchy

Date, venue, speaker, headline — I decide what the eye should hit first, second and third, then design the type and layout to enforce that order.

03

Compose & edit

Photo retouching, typography and color come together in Photoshop or Canva, adapted to the format the event actually needs — print, story, or banner.

04

Deliver in every size

Final creatives are adapted across formats — poster, social post, stage backdrop — so the same message travels cleanly everywhere it needs to appear.
